en: 🎉 The browser button is officially here

Testing is over: TextFold's button is now in the Chrome Web Store, for Chrome, Brave and Edge 🧩 We've long felt that the good stuff isn't only in PDFs anymore. It's in technical blogs, on publishers' article pages, in the posts you sign in or subscribe to read. Now, when you find one worth reading, one click puts it in TextFold 📥 The page is folded into five levels and opens right beside the original, so you can skim the gist or read every word. Highlights, notes, questions and translation all work just as they do with papers ✨
zh: 🎉 浏览器插件正式上线
测试结束啦！TextFold 的浏览器按钮正式上架 Chrome 网上应用店，Chrome、Brave、Edge 都能装 🧩 我们一直觉得，好内容早就不只在 PDF 里：技术博客、出版社的文章页，还有要登录或订阅才看得到的文章。现在看到一篇想读的，点一下就进了 TextFold 📥 网页会折成五层，在原网页旁边打开，扫一眼大意还是逐字细读都随你。高亮、笔记、提问、翻译，和读论文时一样好用 ✨

en: Edit a translation

Select words in a translation and choose Edit translation: the whole translation opens at them, one sentence a line as in the original. Save it as it is, or have its shorter levels written again from your sentences. Your corrections stay when the text is translated again.
A translation shown as it is made
A language translated for the first time opens as soon as its first section is in, and the other sections come in one at a time.
Figures zoom
An enlarged figure zooms as the original PDF does: − and +, ⌘ or Ctrl and the wheel, a pinch, or a click where you want to look. Drag it to see the rest.
Research blogs as they were made
A web page's interactive figures run in their place, loaded from their site; its formulas are drawn as written, and pictures its page sets side by side stay side by side.
zh: 修改译文
在译文里选中文字，点“修改译文”，整篇译文会在那里打开，和原文一样每句一行。可以只保存，也可以按你改过的句子重新生成较短各层。以后重新翻译，你的改动也会保留。
边翻译边显示
第一次翻译一个语言时，第一节翻好就切换过去，其余的一节一节补上。
图片可以缩放
放大后的图和原文 PDF 一样可以缩放：用 − 和 +、⌘ 或 Ctrl 加滚轮、双指，或者在想看的地方点一下。拖动可以看其余部分。
研究博客按原样显示
网页里的交互图在原来的位置照常运行（从原网站加载）；公式按原样显示，网页并排放的几张图也保持并排。

en: Antigravity as a local agent (experimental)
If Google's Antigravity CLI (agy) is on your computer and signed in, TextFold finds it and lists its models in Settings, as it does Claude Code and Codex.
Claude Code with Verbose output
With Verbose output turned on in Claude Code's /config, every generation used to fail. TextFold now reads its replies either way.
zh: Antigravity 成为本机 Agent（试验）
电脑上装了 Google 的 Antigravity 命令行（agy）并已登录的话，TextFold 会自动找到它，在设置里列出它的模型，和 Claude Code、Codex 一样。
Claude Code 打开 Verbose 也能用
以前在 Claude Code 的 /config 里打开 Verbose output，每次生成都会失败。现在两种输出 TextFold 都能读。

en: 🚀 Your notes, all in one place (beta)

Every highlight, note and question you've left in your texts now gathers under Notes, at the bottom of the sidebar. Wondering "What did I read today?" or "What have I been chewing on this month?" Click a day or a month on the calendar, or drag across a stretch of days, and there it is.
✨ Let your notes recap for you

Pick some notes and choose A recap, text by text: TextFold writes you a short recap of what each text says, what caught your eye, and what you seem drawn to lately. It can also gather them into themes, write a paragraph for your paper, summarize them your own way (+ Your own way, kept as a template), or just answer a question. The recap shows up in the sidebar, every sentence linking back to its source, and it exports to Obsidian; to take the notes themselves, export them as they are. It uses the model you set for questions.
🔍 Zoom the original PDF
Reading beside the original, the PDF now zooms: use − and + at its top, or hold ⌘ (Ctrl on Windows) and scroll, or pinch.
🧪 Still in testing
Tell us on GitHub what feels right and what doesn't.
zh: 🚀 笔记功能升级（测试版）
你在各个文本里留下的高光、批注和提问，现在都汇总到侧栏底部的“笔记”里，可以统一管理了。想知道“我今天都读了什么？”“这个月我在琢磨什么？”，在日历上点一天、点一个月，或者拖出一段日子，马上就能看到。
✨ 让笔记帮你回顾
选好笔记，点“逐篇回顾”，TextFold 会帮你写一篇简短的阅读回顾：每篇讲了什么，你在意了哪些地方，最近你好像在关注什么。也可以按主题归纳、写成论文里的一段，或者点“＋ 自定义总结方式”写下你自己的总结方式，存成模板以后一键使用；直接提问也行。回顾写好后会出现在侧栏，每句话都能跳回原文，也能导出到 Obsidian；只想要笔记本身，可以原样导出。总结和提问用的是你在设置里为提问选的模型。
🔍 原文 PDF 可以放大了
和原文对照着读时，PDF 现在可以放大缩小：点上方的 − 和 +，或者按住 ⌘（Windows 上是 Ctrl）滚动滚轮，或者双指捏合。
🧪 还在测试中
用起来哪里顺手、哪里别扭，欢迎到 GitHub 上告诉我们。

en: Wide content fits the column
A wide picture, table, formula or long link no longer makes the page scroll sideways. Beside the PDF, the text no longer slides under it.
DeepSeek thinks at the level set
The argument links and your questions now ask DeepSeek to think briefly, as set. Before, once its thinking was on, it thought at its default, high, which took longer and cost more.
zh: 宽内容不再撑宽页面
很宽的图片、表格、公式或长链接不再让整页左右滚动。和 PDF 并排时，正文也不会再滑到 PDF 底下。
DeepSeek 按设定的档位思考
论证连线和提问现在让 DeepSeek 按设定的低档思考。以前它一开思考就用默认的高档，更慢，也更贵。

en: Edit the text of any document
Edit text now works on every document: an arXiv paper, a web page, a file, not only a converted PDF. Undo every edit and the document is exactly as it came.
Read a PDF from the file itself
When TextFold finds a PDF you drop online, it reads the online version. To convert the file itself instead, choose Read the PDF itself under Settings › PDF engine › A PDF found online.
Long sections in full
A very long section, or one of many short paragraphs, is now generated in parts, so its levels and its translation are no longer cut off.
Formulas at the size of the text
In a fast conversion, formula pictures now come out about as large as the text around them, with no stray word under them. Convert a PDF again to see it.
zh: 任何文档都能修改原文
“修改原文”现在对所有文档都能用：arXiv 论文、网页、文件，不只是转换来的 PDF。撤销全部修改，文档就和原来一模一样。
PDF 可以直接读文件本身
拖进来的 PDF 如果在网上找得到，TextFold 会读网上的版本。想直接转换文件本身，可以在 设置 › PDF 引擎 › 在网上找到的 PDF 里选“读 PDF 本身”。
长章节完整生成
很长的章节，或者短段落特别多的章节，现在分几部分生成，缩放层级和翻译都不会再被截断。
公式和正文一样大
快速转换的公式图片现在和周围的文字差不多大，下面也不再多出一个词。PDF 重新转换后就能看到。

en: Fix a converted PDF’s text where you read it
Select the words the conversion got wrong and choose Edit text. The text opens at those words. Save, and only the sections you changed are generated again. Your notes stay where they were.
Edit in several places, generate once
Save only keeps an edit without asking the model. When you are done, Edited · Regenerate in the top bar generates each language once.
Your changes, marked in the text
Edit history shows each change on the page: words added are underlined, words removed are struck through. Go from one to the next, undo one, or edit it again. Regenerating accepts them all.
zh: 在阅读的地方改正 PDF 的文字
选中转换读错的字，点“修改原文”，文字会在这几个字的位置打开。保存后只重新生成改过的章节，笔记留在原处。
改好几处，只生成一次
“仅保存”只保存修改，不调用模型。全部改完后，点顶栏的“已修改 · 重新生成”，每种语言只生成一次。
修改直接标在原文上
点“修改记录”，每处修改都标在文章里：新加的字有下划线，删掉的字被划掉。可以逐处跳转、撤销，或者再改。重新生成就是全部接受。
